description: Figure 2 is a vertical bar chart that illustrates the average accuracy across 11 datasets for five different training methods, as labeled along the x-axis: “Standard,” “Self-RAG,” “FactTune,” “CInGS (w/),” and “CInGS.” The y-axis, labeled “Average Performance,” is scaled from 0 to 60 in increments of 10. Each bar represents the mean performance of a specific training method, with distinct colors for visual differentiation: “Standard” is orange, “Self-RAG” is olive green, “FactTune” is lime green, “CInGS (w/)” is teal, and “CInGS” is royal blue. The bar heights indicate that “CInGS” achieves the highest average performance, reaching approximately 58. The “CInGS (w/)” variant follows closely at around 53, while “FactTune” is slightly lower at approximately 51. “Self-RAG” and “Standard” show comparable performance, both around 52 and 51 respectively, with “Standard” being marginally lower. The chart visually emphasizes the superior performance of the CInGS method over the other training approaches.
